what_must_be_consistent_to_feel_like_NAS: Every Core 5 dish reads as Indian-Mexican fusion, tastes of its named anchors, is hot or cold as intended, and follows D-54.
rd_acceptance_criteria: R&D decides now: do the dishes pass the frozen D-74 style gates by name, as written and unchanged? Record results, never reword gates.
future_production_qc: Light check: taste a plate from each shift against a reference; probe-check protein; confirm recipe card was followed.
evidence_trigger: First physically cooked and recorded session; then any change of cook, supplier or equipment
professional_review_required: Food-safety professional; chef; brewer where beer applies

what_must_be_consistent_to_feel_like_NAS: Beer tastes clean, balanced and as the brewer intended, suited to the food, with a consistent house character.
rd_acceptance_criteria: R&D decides now: nothing about brewed beer; no beer exists. Only pairing hypotheses are recorded, and tasting needs a qualified brewer.
future_production_qc: Light check: brewer tastes each batch and keg before release; log sensory notes and any off-flavor.
evidence_trigger: Real brewed batches and a brewer-led tasting
professional_review_required: Food-safety professional; chef; brewer where beer applies

what_must_be_consistent_to_feel_like_NAS: NA drinks feel as designed and cared for as beer, with clear flavor, balance and honest labelling.
rd_acceptance_criteria: R&D decides now: do the proposed NA pairings help the dish in tasting; labelled PROPOSED - NOT SENSORY TESTED until done.
future_production_qc: Light check: taste each NA batch against a reference; confirm date label and hold limit; check allergens.
owner_role: Bar lead (future); food-safety professional sets hold limits
evidence_trigger: First tasting of NA with a cooked dish; any dairy or fruit NA addition
professional_review_required: Food-safety professional; alcohol attorney for any NA beer

what_must_be_consistent_to_feel_like_NAS: Service is warm, attentive, unhurried and honest, with plates arriving in a sensible order and nothing pushed.
rd_acceptance_criteria: R&D decides now: can the test crew serve a plate in the intended time and order without confusion; observation only.
future_production_qc: Light check: shift lead watches pace, delays and guest signals; short end-of-shift note on what slipped.
evidence_trigger: First invited tasting with guests; first paid pop-up
professional_review_required: Operator; alcohol attorney for alcohol rules

what_must_be_consistent_to_feel_like_NAS: Space, tables, restrooms, bar and kitchen look and are clean without looking sterile.
rd_acceptance_criteria: R&D decides now: does the test setup leave tools, surfaces and probes clean; basic record only, no code claim.
future_production_qc: Light check: opening and closing walk with a short list; fix on the spot; log recurring misses.
evidence_trigger: First test in a shared or borrowed kitchen; any health authority feedback

what_must_be_consistent_to_feel_like_NAS: Glass is clean, correct for the drink, unchipped, and equal for NA and beer.
rd_acceptance_criteria: R&D decides now: which glass shapes suit beer and NA drinks in tasting; sensory comparison only.
future_production_qc: Light check: inspect for chips, film and spots at opening; remove damaged pieces; match glass to the drink.
evidence_trigger: First beer or NA pour into candidate glassware

what_must_be_consistent_to_feel_like_NAS: A mistake is fixed fast, plainly and without defensiveness; the guest chooses the fix and is never made to feel at fault.
rd_acceptance_criteria: R&D decides now: do test guests report problems comfortably; record complaints and fixes without defense.
future_production_qc: Light check: staff tell a lead, fix on the spot, and log what happened and what helped; review patterns weekly.
evidence_trigger: First complaint or allergen concern from any guest
professional_review_required: Operator; attorney for allergen or injury incidents
